component.name: Calculator
component.summary: Calculator with standard and scientific modes

description.p: A GTK 4 calculator with a Material 3 Expressive style. It takes its colours from the desktop or from a palette you choose.

ul.li: Live result preview, history and keyboard input
Built-in palettes, a custom accent colour or a palette file

screenshot.caption: Scientific mode with a preset palette

description.p: The app opens from launchers that do not have ~/.local/bin in their PATH.
Decimal separator setting and calculation fixes.

ul.li: New setting: point or comma as the decimal symbol
Pressing = again repeats the right operation after E notation or a negative number
Results reused in a new calculation keep their full precision
Pasting handles exp, Ans, mod and thousands separators
tan at 90° is reported as undefined in radians too
